rv.q: Passing Strange is yet another unmissable show from Theo Ubique By Karen Topham June 26, 2023.
That the narration is rock music and that the characters are wild and often weird; well, it all makes for one super entertaining and wonderful theater experience.
Theo's Passing Strange will take you across all seven seas and back again. Don't pass it up.
For those who enjoy comedic shows about self-discovery, this would be a good fit for you.
Despite obvious pitfalls there is still a lot of fun to be had.

cn.t: Critics praise this energetic rock musical as a touching, sensitive journey through identity and music, with Theo Ubique's intimate production earning strong marks for its explosive performances and poetic storytelling.
